seed_ledger.name: Duke Energy Corp: gas supply to its plants in development (group 2 of 3)
seed_ledger.reason: James E. Rogers (Cliffside) NO_DC_TIE: 2040 coal conversion in the resource plan, no plant-specific gas supply project or data center tie found. Buck NO_DC_TIE: two peaker turbines; residents at a March 2026 hearing objected to data centers generally and a data center developer bought land about a mile away, but no filing ties the turbines to it; no pipeline named. Belews Creek NO_DC_TIE: two 425 MW turbines under study for transmission impacts; Transco Southeast Supply Enhancement (existing row P7108) is Duke's gas source for several new plants but no source ties Belews Creek or a data center to it. Edwardsport NO_DC_TIE: gas conversion by 2030 in the Indiana resource plan, existing site, no pipeline or data center tie found. Duke Energy IRP Power station 1 (Florida) NOT_FOUND: placeholder site, no filing found. Searches run: 9. Sources checked: Duke Cayuga page and Indiana trade press (no Edwardsport tie), WUNC Jan 2026 (Belews turbines, no data center), WFAE Dec 2025 (Transco SESE permits, Duke 1,000,000 Dth/d), WFAE Mar 2026 and Yadkin Riverkeeper Apr 2026 (Buck peakers, general data center concern), Duke Florida search (only the 2018 Citrus plant on Sabal Trail).

evidence.note: Belews Creek two 425 MW turbines, no data center named
Transco SESE permits, Duke rights to 1,000,000 Dth/d
Buck peakers and Davidson County sites near Transco, general data center concern

seed_ledger.name: Duke Energy Corp: gas supply to its plants in development (group 3 of 3)
seed_ledger.reason: Cayuga NO_DC_TIE: two 1x1 combined cycle units approved by the Indiana regulator in Oct 2025, Duke says the site already has gas from east and west pipelines, no new pipe named and no data center tie in the filing coverage. Gibson NO_DC_TIE: 2x1 combined cycle by 2032 in the resource plan, no gas supply project or data center tie found. Marshall NO_DC_TIE: 850 MW peaker pair approved by the North Carolina regulator, no gas lateral or data center named. Lincoln NO_DC_TIE: expansion of an existing 1995 peaker site with gas access, only 2017 coverage found. East Bend NO_DC_TIE: coal to gas co-firing debate in the Kentucky resource plan, no pipeline or data center tie found. Searches run: 7. Sources checked: Duke Cayuga page (existing gas infrastructure, demand growth only), ncnewsline Mar 2024 (Marshall, no pipeline), power-eng Indiana resource plan stories (Gibson, no data center), Kentucky PSC filings (East Bend, no data center), 2017 Duke and Siemens Lincoln coverage.

evidence.note: Cayuga existing gas infrastructure, demand growth
Marshall 850 MW gas plant, no pipeline named
